sources.title: TKCAM: Text and Keyframe to Camera Trajectory Generation
sources.snippet: Generating high-quality and controllable camera motion is essential for AI-assisted cinematography, video synthesis, and 3D scene understanding. We introduce TKCAM, a text- and keyframe-conditioned camera-motion synthesis framework based on generative masked modeling.

sources.title: GitHub - linearalgebrayhz/TKCAM
sources.snippet: TKCAM generates camera trajectories (rotation + translation over time) from text, optionally conditioned on a first frame or sparse keyframes. It adapts the MoMask residual masked-transformer recipe from human motion to continuous camera trajectories, and is evaluated with a contrastive language-trajectory model (CLaTr).
